name: Rebel Droid Partnership
backstory: One partner improvises under pressure; the other insists on a sensible risk assessment. Their workshop spends on a dependable pair before buying anything that needs a larger hangar.
strategy_personality: a compact mobile R2-D2 build beside a defensive, tactical C-3PO build. Concentrate upgrades in the pair. These are proposed arena roles; C-3PO remains a protocol droid in the source, so this stable has a stronger adaptation requirement than the battle-droid army.

robots.name: R2-D2
robots.art_brief:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: one square individual robot portrait for the Armoured Souls game. Create an original robot design with its own construction and proportions. Premium realistic industrial science-fiction 3D render, fine scratches and restrained paint wear, believable materials. Quiet charcoal-to-black studio backdrop, dark floor, faint low haze. Neutral soft key light and cool upper-right rim. Three-quarter view, entire robot, wheels, antennae and tools visible, centered at 80% canvas height with clear margin on all sides. Readable at 512px. One robot only. No text, logos, watermark, frame, interface, collage, firing, explosions or extra characters.
Subject: compact starship maintenance robot with a wide trapezoidal petrol-teal body on two low continuous rubber tracks. Flat slanted upper housing, horizontal amber-glass sensor strip, copper corner guards and access panels. Two small folded precision tool manipulators on the front, recessed cable reels and a short flat communication fin. Rugged practical retro-space machinery, repaired surfaces and calm grounded pose. The unique silhouette is low, broad and tracked; the head is integrated into the sloping body.
robots.refinement_note: Apply only after the final loadout is equipped. Main-hand operations affect that item instance only; a second weapon copy stays unrefined. The shield receives only its listed Hone. No unverified weapon attribute is added.
robots.equipment_interpretation: R2-D2 fills the mobile skirmisher role. Its source body and selected portrait are retained. Arena main/offhand allocations can use fitted mounts or tool adapters; extra limbs, integrated source weapons and alternate forms grant no additional slots or combat effects.
robots.combat_rationale: Sprinter tuning supports the short equipment role; balanced stance and a 20% yield threshold implement its pressure or survival priority. Range follows the equipped weapons at both stages.
robots.tuning_plan: Use the existing Duo strategy tuning rules with the Sprinter Build_Focus and its free pool; equipment refinements do not replace robot tuning.
robots.design_basis: New arena build authored for this collection using supplied equipment prices, hand compatibility and verified refinement examples. Original source identity and final artwork remain authoritative for appearance.

Source proportions, restrained oil stains and weathered paint. No humanoid arms, held gun or invented armour. One complete R2-D2 alone.
Catalogue label for metadata only, do not render text: #102 slot 1 R2-D2.

source_notes:
**Franchise:** Star Wars  
**Strategy:** Duo · **Target roster:** 2 robots  
**Catalogue key:** `rebel-droid-partnership`

**Proposed robots:** R2-D2 and C-3PO.

**Identity:** the galaxy's most familiar droid partnership relies on survival, resourcefulness, and complementary investments.

**Strategy personality:** a compact mobile R2-D2 build beside a defensive, tactical C-3PO build. Concentrate upgrades in the pair. These are proposed arena roles; C-3PO remains a protocol droid in the source, so this stable has a stronger adaptation requirement than the battle-droid army.

**Visual direction:** original-trilogy appearances. R2-D2 keeps his blue-and-white cylindrical body and silver dome. C-3PO keeps his gold protocol-droid body, exposed midriff wiring, and original film details. Use realistic surface wear and the shared studio lighting while retaining their familiar construction. Added combat equipment should remain visually subordinate to their identities.

References: [R2-D2](https://www.starwars.com/databank/r2-d2), [C-3PO](https://www.starwars.com/databank/c-3po/), [companion relationship](https://www.starwars.com/databank/abafar).
purchasing_plan: Open with both robots. Alternate stage-1 equipment investment between slots 1 and 2; finish both final loadouts before refining. Visit both robots in each Hone pass, then each Augment pass, buying Workshop L1/L3 only as required. No Sharpen or Forge purchases.

equipment_budget.excludes: Frames, facilities, training, repairs, upkeep, discounts and resale; stage-1 total replaces stage-0 gear and is not a simultaneous equipment inventory.
